title: Refine homepage collections with editorial category cards
summary: Elegant serif headings, immersive image cards and restrained forest-green details replace the heavy heading and detached captions.

changes.detail: Refined typography, spacing, responsive image cards, gradient-backed labels, product-count badges and collection calls to action.
Removed intersection-observer visibility gating and detached caption dividers; cards remain visible immediately.
Scoped responsive styles, keyboard focus outlines and reduced-motion handling; existing catalogue links and custom image crops preserved.
